name: Crossing Over
source:
Crossing Over is the story of a soul and their journey towards the Hereafter. With the help of Marco, a soul ferrier, they will remember their past and fish unexpected objects out of the ethereal river.

[From [url=https://bad-manners.itch.io/crossing-over]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《穿越》讲述了一个灵魂及其通往后世之旅的故事。在灵魂摆渡者马可的帮助下，他们将记住自己的过去，并从空灵的河流中捞出意想不到的物品。

[来自[url=https://bad-manners.itch.io/crossing-over]Itch.io[/url]]
